headline: How to Avoid Common Countertop Installation Mistakes
articleBody: Getting new countertops can really transform your kitchen or bath, but a few missteps can lead to big headaches. One of the biggest mistakes folks make is not confirming exactly what’s included in the price. You want to know upfront if templating, fabrication, and installation are all covered, and if things like sink cutouts or edge profiles are extra. Another common oversight is not approving the seam placement before fabrication. Trust me, you don’t want a seam in an awkward spot, so make sure you’ve talked through where those will go. Also, remember to have your sink and cooktop on-site, or at least fully specified, before the templating happens. If those aren’t ready, it can definitely hold things up. Lastly, forgetting to prep the site can cause delays. Make sure the area is clear, and think about how debris will be managed. Sometimes cabinets are unfinished or unlevel, which really throws a wrench in the works; it’s crucial to address those things first. Making sure you have proper support for any overhangs is also key—you don't want your beautiful new countertop cracking because it wasn't properly supported. By coordinating these details with your installer, you'll ensure a much smoother process.
